nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the expected global urban population percentage by 2030?
nodes.answer: The global urban population is expected to reach 61% by 2030.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Identify two key drivers of urban change highlighted by the machine learning models in the study.
nodes.answer: Population density and water stress index are identified as key urban change drivers.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the anticipated global population by 2050, and how will this affect food and energy production?
nodes.answer: The anticipated global population by 2050 is about 9 billion, which will require food production to increase by 70% and energy production by 50%.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Which growth model provided the best fit to the growth/age data in the study?
nodes.answer: The Gompertz model provided the best fit to the growth/age data.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_004
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the projected population of Africa by 2050?
nodes.answer: The projected population of Africa by 2050 is 2.5 billion people.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_005
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: By what year is Africa's population expected to nearly double to 2.5 billion?

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_006
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the projected annual population growth rate in Uganda according to the World Bank 2022?
nodes.answer: The projected annual population growth rate in Uganda is 3%.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_007
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the projected urban population by 2050 according to the United Nations?
nodes.answer: The projected urban population by 2050 is expected to reach 6.7 billion.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_008
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What are the two traditional modeling approaches mentioned for simulating socio-ecological systems (SES)?
nodes.answer: The two traditional modeling approaches mentioned are agent-based models (ABM) and system dynamics (SD).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_009
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How does system dynamics (SD) modeling differ from agent-based modeling (ABM) in terms of focus?
nodes.answer: SD focuses more on macro-level feedback loops and causal relationships between components, often overlooking the micro-level heterogeneity of agents, while ABM simulates individual behaviors and interactions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_010
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: According to the UN report, what percentage of the global population resides in the top six hundred cities?
nodes.answer: The top six hundred cities across the globe consist of 20% of the global population.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_011
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the expected world population by 2050?
nodes.answer: The world population is expected to grow to 10 billion by 2050.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Urban planning analytics|Population growth model_qna_012
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How do rural population growth, energy use, and economic growth impact CO2 emissions according to Shari (2021)?
nodes.answer: Shari (2021) explores the impacts of rural population growth, energy use, and economic growth on CO2 emissions, emphasizing the interconnected relationship between these factors and their influence on carbon emissions.
